title: Build the unit-economics model; it is load-bearing in both acquisition branches
description: Derived from ASM-03 on 2026-08-04 and had no home. Under organic, margin must cover the content operation; under the paid-traffic fallback, margin must cover CAC. Nothing in the corpus establishes either. SC-08 in vision.md is still TODO(human) and is now a precondition, not a later exercise. Needs: distributor margin band for the chosen vertical, per-parcel shipping economics (see AUD-04 issue), payment costs, and a CAC assumption with its source.

title: Decide whether sourcing is scoped to the order or the order line (AUD-04)
description: Highest late-fix cost in the audit and it has no home. domain-model.md:25 and glossary.md:22 define SourcingDecision per line; all three strategy options at domain-model.md:42 are per-line optimisations and basket consolidation is absent. Verified absences: 'shipping cost', 'freight', 'carriage', 'consolidation' occur zero times in the corpus, and the feed contract sketch names cost/units/currency/lead time but no shipping tariff, free-shipping threshold or per-parcel handling fee. In dropshipping the customer pays one shipping fee and the operator pays one per supplier parcel, so a per-line cheapest-offer rule splits baskets and destroys more margin than the line saving recovers - systematically and invisibly. ADR-0006 already mandates persisting SourcingDecision per order line, so changing this needs an ADR superseding that part, not an edit. NOT covered by docs-2w2, which is transition tables.

title: Decide where the operator is legally established, then re-derive HF-05
description: Audit AUD-03 joined to the ADR-0007 verification gap. ADR-0007's GPSR distributor conclusion likely survives regardless of establishment - role follows from whether you place goods on the market. But the EPR consequences drawn in market-selection.md HF-05 depend on it, and REG-06 (Authorised Representative for non-established sellers) dates 2026-08-12. HF-05 is currently underivable. Also opens the missing commercial/legal layer: zero occurrences of GDPR, privacy, personal data, legal entity, invoice, KYC in the corpus; one mention of VAT; no PSP decision though iDEAL is called a launch requirement; no DPA though every order sends customer personal data to a supplier.

title: Record the organic-search premise as a risk and hang INV-08 on it
description: Audit AUD-02 joined to the INV-08 finding. The premise: attribute-generated copy, in a language the operator does not speak, on the same distributor feeds every competitor has, can win Dutch organic. Second failure mode, from the auditor: the operator cannot assess the quality of that content himself, so the premise can fail SILENTLY - months of output with no internal signal that it is not working. INV-08's second term (CWV/SEO above maintenance and time-to-launch) exists only if the premise holds; ADR-0001, ADR-0002 and ADR-0003 are downstream of that ordering. Blocks the INV-08 half of docs-i6p.
close_reason: ASM-03 recorded in 00-product/assumptions.md with both failure modes, and as a structural risk in vision.md. Paid traffic named as the fallback, which upgrades SC-08 from deferrable to blocking. INV-08 demoted to ASM-02 and hung on ASM-03.

title: Justify or retire INV-01, INV-03, INV-07, INV-08 - four invariants with no decision record
description: Four invariants are stated as fact with no ADR deriving them: INV-01 (one Magento instance for 10-20 websites at feed scale, an untested capacity bet), INV-03, INV-07, INV-08. Audit 2026-08-04 joins this to AUD-07 (Phase -1 exit gate is a 19x3 matrix that exists nowhere as a matrix) and to the docs-check weakness: one pattern, not three defects. The repo declares a constraint and never builds the instrument that could falsify it. Remedy for all three together: for every asserted constraint, name what would disprove it.
close_reason: INV-01 -> ASM-01 and INV-08 -> ASM-02, both with falsifiers. INV-03 derivation named (automation charter), with an OPEN on deriving an invariant from a living doc. INV-07 derivation found to exist in ADR-0001 and ADR-0003 but mislabelled INV-05 - completing it is docs-cn2, not this issue.

description: market-selection.md names this as the one criterion (MC-04) it could not settle from public sources. Need search volume, top-10 domain strength, and whether bol.com and the incumbent DIY chains hold the head terms.

title: Decide where agent-instruction authority lives (AUD-13)
description: ADR-0004 makes the docs repo the single source of truth, yet claude-project-instructions.md is a second agent-instruction surface with independent content, no sync mechanism, and demonstrated drift: it names clothing and tableware as vertical examples though market-selection excluded apparel on returns and flagged tableware fragile; it knows nothing of ADR-0007's distributor-only sourcing gate (INV-10, INV-11); it knows nothing of beads and still assumes the docs carry the queue. It is the first context a strategic conversation loads, so it misframes before any doc is read. Options: (a) reduce it to a pointer at INDEX.md so it has nothing to drift with, (b) generate it from the corpus as a session-close step, (c) accept two surfaces and define the sync obligation explicitly. Rejecting the finding is option (c) by default and must be recorded as such. The mechanical half - putting the file under version control - stays in docs-e2h.

title: Set an appetite and bind scope to solo capacity (AUD-05)
description: vision.md:37 calls single-operator capacity the binding constraint on every plan, and nothing models against it. roadmap.md:12 cites Shape Up, whose central mechanism is the appetite - fixed time, variable scope - and no appetite is stated for any phase or artefact. Every roadmap exit gate is a quality gate; none is an effort or elapsed-time gate. ADR-0001's revisit trigger, 'solo operation of two runtimes proves unsustainable in Phase 1', has no metric, no threshold and no observer - it will fire as burnout rather than as a measurement.

title: Specify the exception surface - owner, container, contract (AUD-06)
description: VERIFIED. Readiness-test question 6 requires an escalation path carrying enough context to act on; the charter's north star makes human attention the exception path. c4-context.md:15 has an ADMIN node and that is the only mention - no c4-container row, no runtime, no repo, no owner, no entity in domain-model.md, no state machine, no contract. Failure modes already routed to a human with nowhere to land: unmatched products (VC-03), incomplete content (VC-04), feed quarantine (VC-02), sourcing failure, PO rejection, backorder, partial fulfilment, stale offers, reconciliation drift. Second consequence: until this exists, readiness-test question 6 cannot be answered by any design and the charter's central instrument becomes ceremonial.

title: Name the acquisition scope boundary in the automation charter
description: Audit AUD-01, narrowed. VC-04 already covers product-level copy with a publishability rule; what is genuinely absent is market-level work - translation and localisation, SEO assets (category copy, meta, internal linking), merchandising. Prefer the audit's second remedy over the first: do not append VC-20+. VC stages have an owner component, a contract and a state machine; merchandising has no trigger-vs-judgement answer in the same sense and forcing it in dilutes the instrument. State the boundary and name the doc that owns acquisition.

title: Harden docs-check.py to the conventions it claims to enforce
description:
Verified 2026-08-04 with six probes. The orphan check is inert for every ROUTED directory - line 67 passes any file whose parent directory string appears anywhere in INDEX.md, and the routing table names all nine. It DOES fire for a directory absent from INDEX.md entirely.

Design input: three link-check exemptions in two days is not a growing list, it is a wrong default model. The check assumes every .md under docs/ is a routed living doc; the corpus has at least four real classes - living routed, templates, archive, work products - and they differ in which checks apply, not only in lifetime. A work product like audit-2026-08-04.md legitimately carries forward references to files it proposes creating; that difference is what produced the exemption. The fix is a doc_class field in frontmatter selecting the applicable check set, not a wider predicate. It repairs the orphan check and the link check with one mechanism instead of two.

Constraint on that design: doc_class must be the sole authority for check-set selection and must NOT be derivable from status. Where class correlates with status, derive it rather than duplicate it - encoding the same fact in two fields reproduces AUD-16 inside the new mechanism: two diverging truths and no consistency check between them.

Also unvalidated today: paths in related: frontmatter, and markdown [](...) links.

title: Define the procedure for correcting an error in a frozen document
description: CONVENTIONS says ADRs are frozen on acceptance and never edited. It gives no way to fix an error in one. Blocking a real fix: ADR-0001:25, ADR-0001:26 and ADR-0003:31 cite INV-05 (dropshipping) where INV-07 (no proprietary vendor runtime) is meant - the wrong constraint quoted as justification. Options: an erratum block, a superseding ADR, or an explicit carve-out for factual corrections that do not change the decision.

description: OpenSearch 2.19+, Valkey 8 / Redis 7.2, Varnish 7.6/7.7, PHP 8.4, and 'Elasticsearch removed in Magento 2.4.8' are stated as fact and none was verified. CONVENTIONS requires explicit versions; explicit and wrong is worse than vague.

title: Define promotion evidence for automation levels L0-L3 (AUD-20)
description: VERIFIED. SC-07 targets L2+ per stage; the charter defines the levels semantically and never says what evidence promotes a stage. All 19 currently read L0, correctly. The first promotion will be a judgement call with no standard and the north-star metric becomes self-assessed prose. Tie the rule to readiness-test questions 5 and 6, which already require a metric and an exception path - so it depends on the exception surface existing.

title: Add reversibility, appetite and evidence status to the ADR template (AUD-18)
description: ADR-0006 is the strongest artefact in the repo because it does three things the template never asks for: reasons about reversibility, designs the degenerate case, and states accepted cost concretely. 60-decisions/TEMPLATE.md asks only for Context, Options, Decision, Consequences, Revisit triggers. Several findings trace to those absences - unverified claims stated as fact, unmeasurable revisit triggers, scope never tested against capacity.

title: Decide whether an invariant may be derived from a living doc (INV-03)
description: INV-03's derivation is the automation charter, which is status: living. A living doc can change without an ADR, so the invariant's justification can move underneath it. Either freeze the reasoning in an ADR, or accept the coupling explicitly and say why.

title: Batch: dispositions the S3 mechanical findings in audit-2026-08-04.md
description: Mechanical half only. Put claude-project-instructions.md under version control; the question of whether a second agent-instruction surface is permissible at all is docs-97h, which is not blocked on the frozen-document procedure. Plus the remaining S3 items. Read audit-2026-08-04.md section by section - it lives inside the repo. Retire it to 90-archive once every finding is dispositioned; do not delete it.

description: Allegro's share came back as 30%, 45-50%, and 60% across secondary aggregators; the doc uses 'reaches over 80% of Polish online shoppers'. bol.com and NL market-size figures are likewise from aggregators, not primary reports. The regulatory citations are solid; the market figures are the soft spot if the recommendation is challenged.
